en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town with tree‑lined streets and late‑19th‑century houses in the foreground. In the middle distance runs a straight main street flanked by two‑ and three‑story buildings with pitched roofs. A church with a tall steeple and onion‑shaped dome rises above the rooftops near the center. Farmland or open countryside stretches into the background. The word "Ortrand." is printed in red at the upper left on an otherwise blank sky.
